name: Rosewood Washington, D.C.
insider_take: Georgetown's most sophisticated hideaway, where diplomatic elegance meets contemporary luxury just steps from the C&O Canal.
whats_special: This boutique gem occupies a transformed 1960s office building, featuring just 49 ultra-spacious suites averaging 700 square feet. The hotel sits on the historic C&O Canal, originally built in 1828, and offers some of the only waterfront accommodations in Georgetown. Many suites feature original exposed brick walls and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the canal towpath where mules once pulled barges.
pro_tip: Book a Canal View Suite on the second floor for the perfect balance of privacy and water views, plus you'll avoid any foot traffic noise from the popular towpath below.
dont_miss: The hotel's CUT by Wolfgang Puck serves as the only D.C. location for the celebrity chef's steakhouse concept. Take an evening stroll along the C&O Canal towpath, which stretches 184.5 miles to Cumberland, Maryland, or explore Georgetown's cobblestone streets where you'll find the famous Exorcist Steps just blocks away.
pros: Prime Georgetown location with easy access to monuments and attractions
Ultra-luxury accommodations with sophisticated design and premium amenities
Exceptional personalized service with high staff-to-guest ratio
Award-winning dining experiences and rooftop bar with city views
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
Limited on-site recreational facilities compared to resort properties
